USUBJID = STUDYID || "-" || SITEID || "-" || SUBJID, for example LORNA-SITE001-SUBJ001.
Sequential number assigned within each USUBJID after sorting the domain by its key variables.
--DY = (date of --DTC) - (date of DM.RFSTDTC) + 1 when --DTC is on or after RFSTDTC; otherwise (date of --DTC) - (date of DM.RFSTDTC). Missing when either date is incomplete.

MethodDef.Name: Algorithm to derive EPOCH and TAETORD from SE

Description.TranslatedText: EPOCH and TAETORD are taken from the subject element in SE whose interval from SESTDTC up to SEENDTC contains the start date of the record (AESTDTC, DVSTDTC or DSSTDTC). A record dated on the end date of the last element is assigned to the last element.

MethodDef.Name: Algorithm to derive EPOCH and TAETORD from the visit

Description.TranslatedText: EPOCH and TAETORD follow the planned visit: Screening and the pre-dose Baseline (Day 1) assessments belong to the SCREENING element (TAETORD 1); doses and assessments at Baseline (dose), Weeks 4, 8 and 12 belong to the TREATMENT element started at that visit; the Follow-up visit belongs to FOLLOW-UP.
Planned study day of the visit, taken from TV.VISITDY by VISITNUM.

MethodDef.Name: Algorithm to derive RFSTDTC and RFXSTDTC

Description.TranslatedText: Date of the first dose of study drug: the earliest EX.EXSTDTC for the subject.

MethodDef.Name: Algorithm to derive RFENDTC and RFXENDTC

Description.TranslatedText: Date of the last dose of study drug: the latest EX.EXENDTC for the subject.
Date of the last visit attended. If an adverse event ends after that visit, RFPENDTC is the latest AEENDTC (applies to SUBJ037: 2023-05-05).
DTHFL = "Y" if the subject died (DTHDTC populated); otherwise null. No subject died in this study.

MethodDef.Name: Algorithm to derive ACTARMCD and ACTARM

Description.TranslatedText: Arm code and description of the treatment actually received, from EX.EXTRT. Every subject received the treatment assigned, so ACTARMCD = ARMCD and ACTARM = ARM.

MethodDef.Name: Algorithm to derive ARMNRS and ACTARMUD

Description.TranslatedText: Populated only when a subject was not assigned or not treated, or was treated off-protocol. Null for all subjects in this study.

One record per element entered, built from the visits attended. SCREENING runs from the screening visit to the first dose; each treatment element starts at a dose (EXSTDTC) and ends when the next element starts; FOLLOW-UP starts when the last treatment element ends. The last element ends at DM.RFPENDTC. ETCD, ELEMENT, TAETORD and EPOCH come from TA for the subject's arm.

MethodDef.Name: Algorithm to derive EXTRT and EXDOSE

Description.TranslatedText: From the treatment assignment (DM.ARM): DRUG A 200 mg, DRUG B 300 mg, PLACEBO 0 mg.
AEACN = "NOT APPLICABLE" if AESTDTC is on or after the date of last dose (DM.RFXENDTC); otherwise "DOSE NOT CHANGED".
Simulation stand-in for the investigator assessment: "POSSIBLY RELATED" for subjects on Drug A or Drug B, "UNLIKELY TO BE RELATED" for subjects on placebo.
AEOUT = "RECOVERED/RESOLVED" when AEENDTC is populated and the event was not fatal (true for every event in this study).

INFORMED CONSENT OBTAINED: date consent was signed (CRF page 1; equals DM.RFICDTC). RANDOMIZED: randomisation takes place at Baseline (Day 1), so DSSTDTC = DM.RFSTDTC. COMPLETED: date of completion (CRF page 9; equals DM.RFPENDTC).
DVSCAT = "IMPORTANT" when the missed visit is Week 12 (primary endpoint visit); otherwise "NOT IMPORTANT".
Scheduled date of the missed visit: DM.RFSTDTC + TV.VISITDY - 1.
Results are collected in standard units: --STRESC = --ORRES, --STRESN = numeric value of --STRESC, --STRESU = --ORRESU. When --STAT = "NOT DONE" the results and both units are null.

MethodDef.Name: Algorithm to derive standard reference ranges

Description.TranslatedText: LBSTNRLO = numeric LBORNRLO and LBSTNRHI = numeric LBORNRHI (the central laboratory reports ranges in standard units). Null, like LBORNRLO and LBORNRHI, when LBSTAT = "NOT DONE".
LBNRIND = "LOW" if LBSTRESN < LBSTNRLO, "HIGH" if LBSTRESN > LBSTNRHI, otherwise "NORMAL". Null when the result is missing.

"Y" on the last non-missing result for each test on or before the date of first dose (DM.RFXSTDTC): normally the Baseline (Day 1 pre-dose) value, or the Screening value when the Baseline result is missing.
AESPID, AECONTRT, AEENRTPT and the serious-event criteria are not submitted: these fields were not captured in the source data, no event was ongoing at the end of the study and no event was serious.
AGEU = "YEARS" when AGE is populated; null when AGE is missing (ages outside 18 to 85 were set to missing).
CMSTDTC and CMENDTC are not submitted: medication dates were not captured in the source data. Every medication is ongoing at the end of the study.
MHSTDTC is not submitted: condition start dates were not captured in the source data.

Values come from the protocol (v1.1) and the trial design, except SSTDTC (earliest DM.RFICDTC), SENDTC and DCUTDTC (latest DM.RFPENDTC) and ACTSUB (number of subjects in DM). Drug A and Drug B are fictional, so TRT has no UNII code and PCLAS is null (TSVALNF = UNK).
Coded values give the code in TSVALCD and the terminology in TSVCDREF and TSVCDVER: CDISC CT 2025-09-26, SNOMED, ISO 3166, ISO 8601 or ClinicalTrials.gov.
Null for every visit: the visit schedule is the same for all arms. ARMCD is Expected in TV, so it is kept; ARM is not included.
